title: Tadapna wo akber ka keh
body:
Tadapna wo akber ka keh keh ke paani
Jhijhakti qaza aur ubharti jawaani
Sirhaane pisar ke pidar sun raha hai
Har hichki ki aawaaz me pani pani
<<DIVIDER>>
Na zainab ki dhaaras na maa ka sahara
bhare ghar se rukhsat hui hai jawani
Qayamat hai ab inqelaabe zamana
Zaeefi ke haato pa uth'ti jawaani
<<DIVIDER>>
Jab asghar humakte hai haato pa sheh ke
ubal ta hai darya chalakta hai paani
Ubalte hai abbas ke ran me aansu
tapakta hai mashke sakina se paani
<<DIVIDER>>
Lute dono aashoor ko karbala me
Nabi ka alam aur ali ki nashaani
Hai ab jalte qaimo me majboor abid
bohot paas shole bohot door pani
<<DIVIDER>>
wo darbaare hakim wo laakho ka majma
Wo bhai ka qissa behen ki zabani
Meri god me aake baitho sakina
sunaau mai bhayya ki tumko kahani
<<DIVIDER>>
Rahe neel baazu e zainab pa baaqi
watan ko gayi karbala ki nashaani
